basis.normalization: The traced parser receives the same wrapper-normalized source shape as parse(): BOM removal, line-ending normalization, leading-tab normalization, NBSP normalization outside strings and comments, and 3-space UDF-body indentation normalization.
basis.caveat: Peggy traces are parser-internal events. Counting only successful rule.match events avoids failed parse attempts, but productions reached only inside a backtracked successful parse alternative may still be trace-visible. The traced parser is intentionally generated without Peggy cache: true because cache changed behavior on real corpus input during this audit.
